note: How a hostile creature fights (crates/asura-world/src/npc/fight.rs). None of these is measured: no capture this tree holds shows the live server's aggro, leash or call-for-help rules, so each value says what it was chosen to do. A creature's own numbers (health, armor, attack, skills) are its definition's combat block in npcs/definitions.json.

aggro_range.doc: A creature notices a living player within this distance of it, in map units. About the client's aggro bubble on the compass (the earshot circle).

assist_range.doc: When a creature notices a player, every idle creature within this distance of it joins the fight on the same player: a group fights together.

leash_range.doc: A creature that is this far from where it was placed gives up, stops attacking and walks back; at home it is restored to full health with nothing on it.

repath_ms.doc: How often a chase asks the path finder again, in milliseconds, when its quarry keeps moving.

repath_distance.doc: A chase asks again sooner once the quarry is this far from the point it was walking to.

skill_ms.doc: How often a creature in reach tries its skills, in milliseconds. The fight refuses one still recharging or too costly, so this only bounds how often it asks.

approach.doc: A creature walks to within this share of its reach (melee, bow or spell range from combat.json) before it stops to fight, so a step by its quarry does not put it out of reach at once.

respawn_seconds.doc: How long a dead creature lies before it stands up where it was placed. 0 is never, as on the live server, where a cleared area stays cleared until the instance closes. A test server can set a time here.

home_radius.doc: A creature walking back is home once it is this close to where it was placed.
